text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Guess what, Trainer?! I've got<n>myself a new fan! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
She's still just a little girl, but as soon<n>as she saw
me singing downtown,<n>she said she fell in love!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? She was even<n>wearing
ribbons that matched mine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe in a few years, we can even<n>be in an idol
group together? Yeah!<n>Let's make that happen!
